text: Elias Okafor broke the deadlock for Harbour City just before halftime with a clever finish from about 12 meters out, scoring after a smart through pass from Marek Barros [#905] [#904]. This goal capped off a long, patient buildup where Harbour City carefully passed the ball 17 times over nearly a minute, keeping control and wearing down Seabrook Town’s defense. Thanks to their precise short passing and teamwork, Harbour City turned a tough game around to lead 1-0 at the break.
